---
name: swap-slot-image-music-video
description: Image, music and video share one residency slot (backend.Swap, -swap-idle) since 2026-09-27; served numbers and the gate that proves loads skip the queue
metadata:
  type: project
---

Since 2026-09-27, `-image`, `-music` and `-video` share one residency slot (`backend/swap.go`). A request loads its own vertical and unloads the other two. `-swap-idle` (default 10m) empties the slot when nothing is asked for. Each vertical is staged once at startup, so a bad checkpoint is still reported at boot.

**Served numbers** (full unit flags, 20 ms sampler):
- 9.4 GB at rest with nothing staged.
- Music resident: 35 GB. Image resident with `-edits 3`: 56 GB. Video peak: 40 GB.
- Worst moment of the cycle: 60 GB. All three resident would have been ~112 GB.
- A switch costs ~25-30 s before an image and ~19 s before a song.

**Why loads skip the device lock:** `vk.Submits()` counts every queue touch. `TestStagingSkipsTheQueue` (`STAGE_GPU=1`) shows that image and music staging make zero submits, so speech keeps the device during a load.

**Why:** the user wanted the three heavy, rarely-used verticals to stop costing their sum. Deployment in `ai.service` was not done as of 2026-09-27.

**How to apply:**
- A new heavy vertical should implement `Swappable` and take the slot.
- The image-generation wait on speech (5-6 s) is not caused by the slot. Image generation holds `Device.Do` for its whole run, with no yield between steps.

Related: [[server-memory-is-not-standalone-memory]], [[image-vertical-qwen-image-21]], [[music-vertical-ace-step]], [[video-vertical-minimax-h3]].

content.text:
Image, music and video now take turns in one memory slot, with the idle unload. I ran the full server through image → music → video → image and then left it idle, and it worked end to end. Only one of the three is ever loaded, and after 10 minutes with no request (`-swap-idle`, 0 turns it off) that one is unloaded too.

**Memory**, measured on the running server with every model in your full `ai.service` config enabled:

| State | Server memory |
|---|---|
| Nothing loaded (after the idle unload) | 9.4 GB |
| Music loaded | 35 GB |
| Image loaded (`-edits 3`) | 56 GB |
| Video at its peak | 40 GB |
| **Worst moment of the whole cycle** | **60 GB** |

With all three loaded at once it would be about 112 GB, which is why your unit currently leaves out image and video. Each old model's memory was fully freed before the next one loaded.

**Switching cost:**
- An image request after a switch takes about 25–30 s longer, and a song about 19 s longer. A 30 s song came back in 20.5 s end to end, most of it the load.
- Unloading takes under half a second.
- Video had no load cost; it already loaded its weights per request, and now it just takes its turn in the slot.

**Speech stays responsive during switches.** Before letting loads skip the GPU lock, I checked that loading the image and music models submits no GPU work: I added a counter to `vk/engine.go` and a test for it (`STAGE_GPU=1`). Over the whole cycle, speech took 19 ms at the median and at most 0.86 s during any load.

Two requests were slow: 5.4 s and 6.5 s. Both waited behind an image being generated, because image generation holds the GPU for its whole run instead of pausing between steps like music and video. That was already the case and isn't caused by the slot, but it will matter more once image is back in the unit.

**Other changes:**
- Startup now loads image and then music once each, so a broken model folder still fails at boot. That adds about 25 s to startup.
- A music job waiting on a load reports `stage: "load"`.

The slot is in `backend/swap.go`. Image, music and video each load through it, `cmd/serve/main.go` wires it in and adds the flag, and `API.md` and `TODO.md` record the numbers. Unit tests for switching, idle unload, a failed load and a cancelled wait pass under the race detector.

**Not done:** I haven't changed or redeployed `ai.service`. It still has your uncommitted edit, and a redeploy restarts the live service. When you want it, the line becomes your commented-out full line with `-swap-idle` added:
`-embed -tts -tts-gpu -stt -image -edits 3 -kev -video -music -swap-idle 10m -wyoming 0.0.0.0:10300`
